pins.definition: A food product made from the pressed curds of milk.
A food made from the pressed curds of milk.

situation: A man at a wooden counter cuts a thick wedge from a massive wheel of aged cheese.
subject: the pressed curds of milk
brief: A heavy wheel of pale yellow cheese rests on a dark wooden plank, sliced open to reveal a dense, granular interior studded with tiny crystal pockets. A steel wire knife lies beside it on the table, and the pale texture of the food fills the center of the frame under clean, even light.
